screen.spirit_form.title: Spirit Form
screen.spirit_form.loadout.hint1: Click an ability, then a slot to place it. Slots swap places.
screen.spirit_form.loadout.hint2: Right click clears a slot, clicking the bottom row puts an ability back.
screen.spirit_form.shards.desc: How many Soul Shards can exist simultaneously. Without Shards, items are not preserved after death. The N-th Shard costs N levels.
screen.spirit_form.ability.requirement_r: Reward for King of the Beyond
screen.spirit_form.army.confirm: Click again to delete the soul
screen.spirit_form.army_slots.hint: Each new slot costs more than the last
screen.spirit_form.army_slots.desc: How many souls the Army of the Beyond can store. You start with one slot; each next slot costs as many experience levels as the slots you already have.
stat.spirit_form.darkness.constant: Constant Darkness in form; after leaving: %s s
stat.spirit_form.darkness.constant_none: Constant Darkness in form; none after leaving

ability.spirit_form.sense.desc: Highlights nearby mobs. Details in the Diary of My Death.
ability.spirit_form.possession.desc: Enter a mob and control its body.
ability.spirit_form.touch.desc: Lift a mob into the air and hurl it away.
ability.spirit_form.delirium.desc: A smoke decoy distracts mobs while you turn invisible.
ability.spirit_form.icy_touch.desc: Freezes mobs, water and lava around you.
ability.spirit_form.presence.desc: Peaceful mobs flee, hostile ones attack.
ability.spirit_form.life_gift.desc: Charge costs hearts: the ball heals a mob.
ability.spirit_form.scales.desc: Charge costs hearts: the ball hurts a mob.
ability.spirit_form.gaze.desc: Hostile mobs flee, peaceful ones come to you.
ability.spirit_form.echo.desc: Leaves an echo. Deactivation returns to it.
ability.spirit_form.scream.desc: Mobs nearby turn to your side.
ability.spirit_form.summon.desc: Teleports the entity you are looking at to you.
ability.spirit_form.army.desc: Reward for the advancement "King of the Beyond". Souls of slain creatures become your army. In ability mode (%s) pick this ability: 1 - summon souls, 2 - orders, 3 - delete souls.
order.spirit_form.guard.desc: Souls stay close and attack whoever hurts you.
order.spirit_form.hold.desc: Souls stay in place and attack anyone who comes near.
order.spirit_form.retreat.desc: All souls return to the storage.
order.spirit_form.fury.desc: Guard and attack combined: souls hit both whoever hurts you and whoever you hit. Once in a fight, they finish it.
tooltip.spirit_form.bracelet.1: Speed and strength x2, abilities recover twice as fast. Inverts skin colors.
tooltip.spirit_form.artifact.darkness: Artifact of the Path of Darkness
tooltip.spirit_form.catcher.empty: Empty. Right click a mob to catch it.
tooltip.spirit_form.artifact.movement: Artifact of the Path of Movement
tooltip.spirit_form.necklace.1: While worn, hunger is not spent.
tooltip.spirit_form.artifact.hunger: Artifact of the Path of Hunger
tooltip.spirit_form.scythe.heal: Heals %s-%s%% of damage dealt and half a hunger icon per hit (no effect on undead and golems)
tooltip.spirit_form.scythe.charge_how: Charge is gained instead of a soul, when one would appear
tooltip.spirit_form.scythe.freeze: Right click: a mint smoke circle (%s blocks) freezes mobs for %s s, strength x%s
tooltip.spirit_form.scythe.reaper: Full charge and full set: right click starts Reaping (hits are lethal)
tooltip.spirit_form.scythe.no_form: Spirit invulnerability does not work while holding it
tooltip.spirit_form.crown: Gaze from the Void: shows health and effects of the creature you look at
tooltip.spirit_form.cloak: Edge: first damage after leaving Spirit Form is ignored, first hit after entering it is x10; form cooldown %s s
tooltip.spirit_form.trousers: Elusiveness: after a kill, move twice as fast for %s s
tooltip.spirit_form.boots: Trail: after a kill, leave soul fire behind for %s s; fire does not hurt you
tooltip.spirit_form.set: Full set: Reaper of the Beyond (souls always appear)
spirit_form.configuration.title: Spirit Form Settings
spirit_form.configuration.invisibilityDu: How long invisibility lasts, in seconds.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityHungerC: How many hunger points invisibility and teleportation cost per use.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityCooldow: Cooldown of invisibility and teleportation, in seconds.
spirit_form.configuration.highlightRadiu: Radius in which mobs are highlighted at Darkness level 15.
spirit_form.configuration.levelCosts.too: 15 numbers: experience level cost of upgrade levels 1-15. The first is unlocking the form (level 1), the rest are levels 2-15 of every branch.
spirit_form.configuration.possessRange.t: Maximum distance from which a mob can be possessed.
spirit_form.configuration.teleportSmokeS: For how many seconds extra smoke surrounds the player after a teleport.
spirit_form.configuration.formCooldownSe: Seconds before you can become a Spirit again after draining a possessed mob.
spirit_form.configuration.instinctHunger: How many hunger points one use of Spirit Instinct costs (2 points = one drumstick).
spirit_form.configuration.touchRange.too: How far a mob can be grabbed (blocks).
spirit_form.configuration.touchThrowPowe: Speed a mob is hurled with when the key is released.
spirit_form.configuration.touchImpactDam: Damage per unit of speed when a thrown mob hits a block.
spirit_form.configuration.deliriumDecoyS: How many seconds the decoy stays.
spirit_form.configuration.icyRadius.tool: Water within this radius around the player freezes.
spirit_form.configuration.presenceRadius: Mobs within this radius flee or attack.
spirit_form.configuration.drainHpPerHung: How much mob health becomes one hunger point when leaving the form inside a mob.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityRequire: Spirit Sense, Vanish, Spirit Step and Presence (the last needs all three paths).
Icy Touch, Immunity, Gift of Life, Spirit Gaze (all paths).
spirit_form.configuration.chargeTicks.to: How many ticks to hold the Gift of Life or Scales key to add one unit of charge.
spirit_form.configuration.chargeMax.tool: The largest charge of Gift of Life and Scales.
spirit_form.configuration.chargeRange.to: How far the Gift of Life or Scales ball flies.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityRequire: Path level for the strongest abilities
Possession (all paths), Spirit Touch, Delirium and Scales.
spirit_form.configuration.soulShardLimit: How many Soul Shards a player can have at once. Older ones vanish.
Give the Diary of My Death (needs Patchouli) when the Spirit Form is unlocked.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityCostBas: Experience levels charged for unlocking these abilities.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityCostAdv: Experience levels charged for unlocking these abilities.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityCostMas: Experience levels charged for unlocking these abilities.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityRequire: Required path level for Death's Abode, Spirit Scream, and Summon.
spirit_form.configuration.abilityCostNov: Experience levels charged for unlocking these abilities.
spirit_form.configuration.screamRadius.t: Within what radius (blocks) mobs turn to the player.
spirit_form.configuration.screamDuration: How many seconds mobs stay on the player's side.
spirit_form.configuration.summonRange.to: How far (blocks) the Summon ability reaches the entity you are looking at.
spirit_form.configuration.touchBlockDama: Damage per unit of speed when a thrown block hits an entity.
spirit_form.configuration.touchBlockMaxH: Blocks harder than this value cannot be lifted (obsidian 50, stone 1.5).
spirit_form.configuration.armyMaxSlots.t: The maximum number of souls that can be stored in the Army Storage.
spirit_form.configuration.armySoulChance: The chance that a slain mob will drop a soul (between 0 and 1). Bosses always drop their souls.
spirit_form.configuration.armyWispSecond: How many seconds a wisp waits before being collected.
spirit_form.configuration.scytheMaxCharg: Maximum charge of the Scythe of the Beyond.
spirit_form.configuration.scytheFreezeRa: Radius of the mint smoke circle that freezes mobs (blocks).
spirit_form.configuration.scytheFreezeSe: Seconds mobs stay frozen and the player stays empowered.
spirit_form.configuration.scythePowerMul: Damage multiplier after using the Scythe.
spirit_form.configuration.scytheLockSeco: Seconds the Scythe cannot gain charge after Reaping.
spirit_form.configuration.scytheHealMinP: Minimum percent of damage dealt that heals the player.
spirit_form.configuration.scytheHealMaxP: Maximum percent of damage dealt that heals the player.
spirit_form.configuration.formEdgeCooldo: Spirit Form cooldown while the Cloak of the Beyond is worn.
spirit_form.configuration.gearPerkSecond: Seconds Elusiveness and Trail last after a kill.
spirit_form.curios.book.desc: Notes from one who died but did not vanish. Here, you will find everything regarding the Ghost form, Paths, abilities, and artifacts.
